note: Flags are for human review only; they never change the brief's status or approve it.

flags.sentence: The team recommends reporting lung cancer access times (referral, specialist visit, diagnosis, treatment start) using THL guidance Ohjaus 21/2016 definitions for 16 cancers and flagging stalled handovers, as Health Care Act §52 sets no legal maximum time for a cancer suspicion and the STM roadmap's measure 3.1.2 plans national pathway descriptions and target access times by 2026–2028.
flags.problem: The cited claims for STM roadmap measure 3.1.2 state that national pathway descriptions and cancer-specific access-to-care times by 2026–2028 are planned only for five (unnamed) cancers (with all significant cancers by 2029–2031), so omitting that scope overreaches by implying general or lung-cancer target access times by 2026–2028.

flags.sentence: Given Kymenlaakso’s 0.5% (95% CI 0.2–1.5; n=3/591) crude MDT share versus 6.0% (893/14873) nationally and stage missing for about 48% of patients, the team recommends publishing county recording completeness for stage, drug treatment and MDT coding as data-quality signals while the STM roadmap's measure 3.2.1 plans a quality registry with 90% coverage including stage by 2029–2031.
flags.problem: The cited claims state that under measure 3.2.1 annual reports for at least five cancers are planned by 2029–2031 and that the planned registry has an indicator of 90% coverage including stage, but do not state that 90% coverage will be achieved by 2029–2031.
